: Simply supported beam approximation: δ ≈ 5·q·L⁴ / (384·E·I)
L = the span of the missing tooth, E = the elastic modulus of the material, I = the section moment of inertia, q = the distributed bite force
Example: doubling L raises the deflection by about 16 times, so a long-span fixed bridge is extremely sensitive to abutment load and you should add abutment teeth or switch to a removable or implant restoration.
